customOptions.title: Logo, Lettering & Size
customOptions.text: Your artwork, overall dimensions and proportions. Start with a logo, rough measurements or a reference.

customOptions.title: Light & Finish
customOptions.text: Explore front-lit, halo-lit or non-lit effects, then discuss materials, colour and surface finish.

customOptions.title: Space & Mounting
customOptions.text: Tell us about indoor or outdoor use, the wall surface and your local installation arrangements.

steps.title: Sign In & Share Your Idea
steps.text: Use Google or verify your email, then tell us the style, intended use and delivery country.

steps.title: Discuss the Details & Quote
steps.text: Continue on WhatsApp to review artwork, dimensions, lighting, quantity and delivery needs.

steps.title: Confirm the Specification
steps.text: Review the agreed design, scope, price and delivery arrangements before the order proceeds.

steps.title: Production, Checks & Delivery
steps.text: We make your sign to the confirmed specification, complete the agreed checks and prepare it for delivery.
